posts.cooked: My friend and I was playing the second scenario in the baron blade campaign and we came across the question of, when baron blade is incaped remove a turret from the map. Now does that mean do we remove it from the game as in baron blade does not get that turret for the rest of the game, which would make it so he has a limited number of turrets, or does it mean we just take it off of the map and he gets the turret back, which would make it so he essentially has an unlimted number of turrets at his disposal. Also when barond blade hits a hero with the purpolsion turret and move them X amount of hexs does the elevation take into play with that?

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: My Tactics FAQ answers a question like that. Pretty sure it just means to put it back in the box, meaning it goes back in the pool of possible tokens he can get out later, not that he can never put out that token ever for the rest of the game.
